content.text: {"vat": "Bricklayer's flat-brimmed dark hat (workman's headgear)", "dac_diem": "A bricklayer on a scaffold wears a dark, rounded, low-crowned hat with a short brim, a pale shirt and dark trousers or apron. He is working beside a brick wall with a mortar tub. The scaffold is made of lashed timber poles. The image has no military insignia, uniform or weapons.", "co_tu_nam": null, "da_co_nam_1667": "yes", "ly_do": "Plain brimmed felt or wool hats were common working-class headgear in the 17th century. This is not a uniform, insignia or weapon, and nothing in it looks anachronistic for 1667."}
